description: A hash generator for SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

algorithms.description: Which digests to compute, from SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512. One hex digest comes back per algorithm named.

text.description: The text to hash. It is encoded as UTF-8 before hashing, exactly as given.

name: hash_generator
title: Hash Generator
